public_note: This EMA table carries TWO different 1-5 response ladders and nothing in the resp values distinguishes them: Q1-Q10 are momentary affect items scored 1 'Not at all' to 5 'Extremely', while Q11-Q18 are duration items scored 1 '0 min', 2 '1 - 15 min', 3 '15 - 60 min', 4 '1 - 2 hours', 5 '> 2 hours'. Do not read one common scale across the table. Item wording is transcribed from the deposit's administered survey form (Measures_EMA.pdf), which differs in several places from the paraphrased Item column of Codebook_EMA.xlsx.

Preprint: Fried & Epskamp (2022), 'Mental Health and Social Contact During the COVID-19 Pandemic: An Ecological Momentary Assessment Study', doi:10.31234/osf.io/36xkp. Instrument: Schwarzer, R., & Jerusalem, M. (1995). Generalized Self-Efficacy scale. In Weinman, Wright & Johnston, Measures in health psychology: A user's portfolio. Windsor: NFER-NELSON.
note: MAPPING is a number-preserving rename with no positional step. data/mhscdc_fried_2020.r calls process_dass_data(bt_df, "Pre", 46, 55, ...) which selects num_range("Pre", 46:55) from clean_prepost.csv and pivots with names_to = "item", so the live code IS the deposit column name. Codebook_Baseline.xlsx keys its wording to a cleandata_pre column reading Q46..Q55 with the Label/Scale cell 'Self-Efficacy' on the Q46 row; the Q numbering equals the Pre numbering, which is established rather than assumed - all 11 of the codebook's scale-block anchors (Q1 DASS, Q22 Conscientiousness, Q34 Anger, Q41 Loneliness, Q46 Self-Efficacy, Q56 Mindfulness, Q68 Perceived Stress, Q78 Tiredness, Q86 Motivation, Q102 Smartphone Addiction, Q141 Procrastination) fall exactly on the block starts the processing script hard-codes, and the deposit's own Pre46..Pre55 columns reproduce the live per-item mean/sd to 2dp (max deviation 0.010) including the distinctive fingerprint that Pre46 and Pre54 alone cap at 3. TEXT taken from Measures_Baseline.pdf (the administered form), NOT the codebook: the codebook's Item cells have internal commas stripped, e.g. 'Thanks to my resourcefulness I know how to handle unforeseen situations' where the form reads '...resourcefulness, I know...'. The two agree word for word otherwise (10/10, punctuation-insensitive). Item Pre55 carries a trailing period in both sources and the other nine do not; transcribed as found rather than normalised. INSTRUCTIONS left blank: the form shows only the page header 'Questionnaire 5' before this block. SINGLE LADDER: all ten items use 1 = Not at all true, 2 = Hardly true, 3 = Moderately true, 4 = Exactly true, as printed under each item in the form and in the codebook's Values cell on the Q46 row. DICTIONARY CAVEAT: the IRW Description says 'EMA Self-Efficacy Scale' but these items are from the BASELINE assessment, not the EMA stream - Codebook_EMA.xlsx contains none of them. RIGHTS: clears positively, not by silence. note: Level-1 source: codebook.txt inside http://openpsychometrics.org/_rawdata/KIMS.zip keys each data.csv column Q1..Q39 to its full item wording and states the five anchors (1=Never or very rarely true ... 5=Very often or always true), so code and text are tied at the source with no inference. Code derivation is a number-preserving rename, not positional: data/mindfulness_assessment.R lowercases the headers, drops the four subscale composites, gender and (into cov) age, recodes 0 -> NA, and sets item = as.numeric(str_replace(item,'q','')), so IRW item i IS source column Qi. Re-ran that derivation over the released data.csv anyway: for all 39 items the non-missing n, the mean and the count of each of the five levels reproduce the live table exactly (e.g. item 1 n=601 mean 3.607321 counts 17/60/172/245/107; item 29 mean 3.993289), and all 39 count vectors are mutually distinct, so no permutation could reproduce them. Step 3b: the table's opaque name resolves correctly -- 39 items on a 1-5 scale is the KIMS, and the live item content matches the codebook's KIMS items, not any other measure in the deposit. Deviations from literal transcription: CP1252 decode of the curly apostrophes, stripped 'Qn. ' prefix and trailing space, collapsed internal double spaces in items 19 and 38. instructions left blank (deposit records none; test page 404). resp stored raw, not reverse-scored.

note: IRW item codes ARE the .dta column names (data/mistry_2022_hardship.py melts ITEM_COLS = the literal Stata column names memory/comorbidity/concern/overwhelmed/difficulty_food/difficulty_medicine/difficulty_earning/routine_medical_difficult), so there is no mapping step and Step 5b is exempt under derivation pattern 1 (core model s3). item_text comes from those same columns' Stata variable labels, with the 'RECODE of qNN_x (' wrapper and closing paren stripped; option_text comes from each column's own value label set (comorbidity uses label set 'comorbidity_r'), all 8 coded 1=absent 2=present and remapped 1->0, 2->1 by the processing script, matching the shipped resp 0/1. 5 of 8 labels hit Stata's 80-char cap; difficulty_food, difficulty_medicine and routine_medical_difficult ship the full QAICPOA Q12/Q13/Q14 wording (doi:10.1093/gerona/glaa099, Table 1) because their surviving label wording is an exact character-for-character prefix of QAICPOA (50/45/50 chars; the 80-char cap is on the RAW label, which includes the 'RECODE of qNN_x (' wrapper), and concern's complete label is QAICPOA Q1 verbatim; memory and difficulty_earning ship the truncated label verbatim, unpadded. option_text is the collapsed-binary recode's labels, not the administered options. Administered in Bengali, no Bengali text in the deposit (S1 Data .dta is the only supplementary file), so English in the base fields under the translated_substitute fallback; translation_source=mixed because 5 items' English is the study's own labels (study_supplied) and 3 items' English is the parent instrument's published wording. Rights: deposit is CC BY 4.0 (PLOS ONE), so the study's own wording ships. For the QAICPOA the rights holders reserve nothing on the instrument -- the article states 'A formatted version of the questionnaire, a phone script, sample cover letter, and annotated version of the questionnaire are available at qaicpoa.com' and 'We encourage studies to administer this questionnaire'; the OUP front-matter 'All rights reserved. For permissions, please e-mail: journals.permissions@oup.com' is a notice about the article, not a term governing the instrument (the PANAS case), and no fee, non-commercial, no-derivatives, no-redistribution or permission-required clause on the questionnaire was locatable. Silence is permission, so not blocked.
public_note: For mistry_2022_hardship the option_text values are the labels of the collapsed binary recode the deposit ships ('No difficulty'/'Some difficulty'), not the response options respondents were offered, which for the food, medicine and routine-care items were None/some/much/unable or very difficult; and the item_text for memory and difficulty_earning is cut off mid-phrase because the source Stata variable labels hit Stata's 80-character cap
